Looking at the source document, I compared all numeric dose/amount values mentioned against the extracted list.

**Analysis:**

The extraction captured the vast majority of dose amounts correctly (1.6 mcg/kg/day, the pediatric weight-based ranges, 200/300 mcg/day thresholds, 12.5-25 mcg increments, 1.0 mcg/kg/day, one-fourth replacement dosage, and 5-10 mL for suspension).

However, one numeric threshold value present in the source was omitted. The extraction included "20 mIU per litre" (from the monitoring section, Section 2.4), but did not include the parallel/analogous threshold value "10 mIU per liter" that appears in Table 3 (used to distinguish starting dosage categories: "New onset hypothyroidism (TSH ≥10 mIU per liter)" → 1.6 mcg/kg/day vs. "New onset hypothyroidism (TSH < 10 mIU per liter)" → 1.0 mcg/kg/day).
